messages:
Priya: Hey everyone — I'm Priya (joining Eng Runtime). Quick onboarding q: who do I ping for laptop provisioning, badge, and VPC access? Also who is the owner for model-serving infra (routing/fallbacks) so I can shadow them this week? Thanks!

lina: Welcome Priya! Ping @people-ops for the badge — people-ops channel or people-ops@redwood.com. For laptop, please fill this JIRA: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/IT-SETUP and tag assignee @ash.

ash: Hey Priya — I handle laptops. What machine do you want? We usually issue MacBook Pro unless you need a GPU VM. I can start the order today if you confirm.

infra-bot: infra-bot: New hire checklist updated — badge, laptop, mac setup, VPC onboarding. Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/onboarding/new-hires

Sam W: For VPC access, ping #eng-infra. Your request should include: VPC project name, required CIDR ranges, and which services you need. I can loop in infra oncall to speed it up.

Priya: Thanks — also can you point me to the owner for model-serving? I want to sit with them to learn routing/fallback policies and rollout playbooks.

Eva: That's me — Eng Runtime owns model-serving infra. Happy to do a 30-min shadow tomorrow. I manage runtime/serving, routing policies, and the fallback matrix. I can also share our ownership matrix (who owns fallbacks, model variants, routing).

Sam W: +1. Quick org note so it's clear: Eng Runtime (Eva) -> runtime/serving; Eng Platform (lina) -> deploy & rollout policies; Eng Infra -> networking/regions. Escalation: for latency/throughput regressions page eng-runtime-oncall; for infra/node/GPU issues page eng-infra-oncall.

Priya: Awesome. Can you drop the oncall channels and any short checklist I should add to my runbook?

Eva: Sure — pagerduty: https://pd.redwood.com/teams/eng-runtime. Slack: @eng-runtime-oncall in #eng-runtime. Short triage runbook: 1) check runtime metrics dashboard (rt-dashboard), 2) inspect recent deploys and model versions, 3) trigger fallback to CPU-variant or older model per playbook. I'll DM the full playbook and add you to the docs.

lina: I'll add you to the VPC onboarding doc and the team calendar for the intro. Also cc'ing @ash for laptop ETA.

ash: Laptop ordered — expect shipping in 3-5 biz days. If you need temporary cloud access, I can spin up a dev VM in your region today. Reply with preferred region (us-west1/us-east1/eu-west1).

Priya: us-west1 please. Thank you all! :tada: Looking forward to the shadow.
